resources.description: Fetch items from an Apify Actor run default dataset. Body: { "token": "..." } from actors/call. First call per wallet pays via x402 proportional to Apify usage (capped at $1.00); SIWX replay is free. Poll /api/actors/status until terminal — calling before terminal returns 409. POST only — never GET; token in JSON body, not query string.
